Dear colleagues,

I have an open University Assistant position and seek a highly motivated 
post-doc candidate who is eager to join the Game Computing Group of the 
Institute of Computer Graphics at Johannes Kepler University Linz, Austria.

We welcome applicants with research interests broadly related to the 
areas of games user research, games analytics, gameplay visualization, 
and related areas. The focus will be on designing, implementing, and 
evaluating prototypes, analytical tools, and game-based systems for 
furthering our understanding of players.

Candidates with a strong background in computer science, HCI-related 
research, data science, or information visualization are particularly 
encouraged to apply.

The position is full-time for 6 years. Knowledge of German language is 
not mandatory. The deadline for application is December 1, 2026 with an 
earliest starting date of March 31, 2027. For more information about the 
positions please visit:
Feel free to reach out directly to me if you have questions!
